TSP-V2 Phase 2 — P2-L02: C1 vs C3 across the mandatory preset matrix

Regression text: canonical sentence (Master §11.3) repeated ×30 as a synthetic pagination-stress fixture (clearly not literary sample text — used only to exceed every preset's page-1 capacity so each candidate's own real limit is visible).
Font: Shippori Mincho, same for C1 and C3 in every preset below. All page/margin/font/capacity values read read-only from src/constants/paperSizes.ts PAPER_SIZE_TEMPLATES — see evidence/P2_L02_MULTIPRESET_MEASUREMENTS.md for the full table.
C1: explicit absolute-positioned grid, fixed at the preset's declared page-1 capacity (charsPerLine × linesPerColumn), zero per-glyph correction.
C3: plain native writing-mode:vertical-rl, given far more text than fits, clipped to the same physical page-1 box — the browser's own line-breaking/kinsoku decides how much is actually visible, independent of C1's declared capacity number.
No typography/punctuation correction rules were added or changed in this loop.
Known open item: B5/B6/新書's computed "justified" charPitch comes out 18-44% larger than their declared font size (vs. ~5% for 文庫/A5/A6) under this script's simplified reproduction of the documented capacity formula — this may be intentional existing product design, or may mean this script doesn't fully reproduce src/lib/pageLayout.ts's real computePageLayout clamp logic (not read in this loop). See evidence/P2_L02_MULTIPRESET_MEASUREMENTS.md §3. Whether C3's actual browser-rendered capacity matches C1's declared number was not independently measured in this loop (no rendering/screenshot tool used) — please inspect visually.
